_about: CODE2 v1 (laneCODE2, Code2Cfg.cs). Three separate blocks, each with its own enabled. File missing or enabled=false = all three do nothing.

tether._about: ZoneRuntime.TetherStep. Boss out of its arena (flat distance to centre > radius, or y < minY) is put back at its home spot. z6: ring centre (0,282), play_areas disc 15 + lane |x|<=6; the 10 Nov fall happened at z 298.6 (16.6 m), so 15.5 keeps the last point on the ring ground. Other bosses ship disabled: turn on after a look.

rigClone._about: RagdollRig.Heal on a clone (ZoneRuntime Instantiate copies the serialized Built flag but not the part lists): also reset Converted / Frozen / SimTime, log only the first logMax heals (was one line per spawn, 182 in the logs). The rebuild itself already worked (KILLBUG v1).

npcSnap._about: HubNpcs.Place: the spawn ray lands on the ground collider top (y 0) while the visible terrain is -0.05 (hub, z7). yOffset lowers the feet, lowestHitBandM > 0 first takes the lowest hit within that band below the first hit, maxDropM caps the total lowering. Rows by zone id (HubData.zone).
